verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm that sells legal advisory services, not a software product with an in-product interface where tasks could be handed to a built-in AI assistant. That makes this story a category error for this kind of offering. Its AI-related material is legal advice about AI and a GenAI regulation whitepaper, and its only digital tool is a DPDPA compliance assessment; none of this shows the firm ships an agentic assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
